data.headline: Stock up 4 weeks now to lock in current bean costs before prices climb further
data.why: Arabica futures are at a late-August high and roasters are buying physical beans at higher prices. Adding four weeks of inventory today avoids the cost rise that the model shows would cut profit by the figures above. Cash on hand covers the extra holding cost and the payback arrives by week 13.
data.watch_out: If the Arabica rally reverses quickly, you will hold higher-cost bags while the rival keeps a lower shelf price, squeezing margins for several weeks.
data.recheck_when: Re-check when Arabica futures drop back below the late-August level or a new harvest report signals ample supply.
